title: How to Paraphrase to Avoid Plagiarism in Academic Writing
skills: preserve source meaning while changing wording and sentence structure
distinguish effective paraphrasing from patchwriting or copying
integrate paraphrased evidence ethically into research and analytical writing
alignment_note: Explains how to paraphrase academic source material while preserving meaning and avoiding plagiarism. Supports academic integrity, research writing, source integration, revision, and ethical use of evidence across high school English courses.
